summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for Next.js third-party script optimization using Script component loading strategies. It does not match any existing skill in asset_type, granularity, task_family, method_family, or semantic capability. Existing skills cover JSON library configuration (circe), image optimization, font loading, and bundle analysis—none address script loading strategy control. Peer candidates (Image Optimization, Font Loading Optimization, Bundle Analysis) are complementary asset optimization skills in the same domain but target different asset types (images, fonts, bundle analysis) and do not subsume script optimization.
